statement: Let u be the unique root in [533/1000,267/500] of 256u^7+256u^6-96u^5-80u^4+40u^3+30u^2-15u-5=0. For the frozen set Omega_{5/2}=(-1,1) union (3/2,7/2) union (-7/2,-3/2), the exact Turan constant is T_R(Omega_{5/2})=((2u+1)^2(4u^2-6u+1)^2)/(128u^6-20u^2+5). This settles the exact value in the full frozen scope; it does not classify extremizers.
contribution: An exact normalized cubic-square primal certificate and a matching exact positive three-atomic dual moment certificate close both sides of the finite optimization. The contribution is submitted as a full resolution of the frozen exact-value task, without a claim of priority or of formal open-problem status.
